params.label: 分辨率
params.desc: Video resolution - 480p for faster generation, 720p for balance, 1080p for high quality.

params.label: 草稿
params.desc: Generate a draft preview at 480p, overriding resolution. Returns a draft_id for completing the draft at 1080p within 7 days.

params.label: 时长
params.desc: Duration of the video in seconds. Supports 4 to 30 seconds, or auto to let the model decide based on the prompt.

params.label: 比例
params.desc: The aspect ratio of the generated video. Use 16:9 for landscape, 9:16 for portrait/vertical, 1:1 for square, 21:9 for ultrawide cinematic, or auto to let the model decide.

params.label: 生成音频
params.desc: Whether to generate synchronized audio for the video, including sound effects, ambient sounds, and lip-synced speech. The cost of video generation is the same regardless of whether audio is generated or not.

params.label: 码率模式
params.desc: Output bitrate mode. 'high' requests a higher-quality, larger-file encode from the model; 'standard' uses the default bitrate.

params.label: 编码
params.desc: 'auto' retains default video codec behaviour; 'H264' uses H.264; 'H265' uses H.265.

params.label: 种子
params.desc: Random seed for reproducibility. Note that results may still vary slightly even with the same seed.
